name: member_primary_key_unique
detail: Every member has one canonical record.

name: event_primary_key_unique
detail: Product event IDs are unique.

name: listing_primary_key_unique
detail: Listing IDs are unique.

name: event_member_referential_integrity
detail: All product events resolve to a known member.

name: anonymous_identity_maps_to_one_member
detail: An anonymous browser or app identifier never resolves to multiple members.

name: accepted_event_names
detail: The event stream conforms to the governed tracking plan.

name: events_not_before_member_join
detail: No known-member event predates the member record.

name: listing_member_referential_integrity
detail: All listings resolve to a known member.

name: listing_sale_after_creation
detail: A sold timestamp cannot precede listing creation.

name: touch_member_referential_integrity
detail: All campaign touches resolve to a known member.

name: accepted_consent_statuses
detail: Consent history uses governed status values.

name: campaign_date_consent_snapshot_reconciles
detail: Campaign-date member consent flags reconcile to consent history.

name: audience_has_channel_consent
detail: Every activated member has campaign-date consent for the selected channel.

name: audience_has_no_suppressed_members
detail: Suppressed members never enter the activation audience.

name: audience_respects_contact_cap
detail: Eligible members have received fewer than two marketing contacts in seven days.

name: audience_has_no_campaign_conflict
detail: High-priority journeys and holdouts are excluded.

name: audience_is_lapsed_and_recently_active
detail: Audience members are both 90-day lapsed sellers and recently active.

name: experiment_assignment_unique
detail: Each eligible member receives exactly one experiment assignment.

name: accepted_experiment_variants
detail: Assignments use only pre-registered experiment variants.

name: assignment_precedes_campaign
detail: Randomization is completed before campaign exposure.

name: all_audience_members_randomized
detail: No eligible audience member is missing an assignment.

name: no_ineligible_member_randomized
detail: Assignments contain no member outside the governed audience.

name: control_receives_no_campaign_message
detail: The control group remains unexposed.

name: treatments_receive_one_campaign_message
detail: Every treatment member receives one initial campaign touch.

name: experiment_groups_balanced
detail: Deterministic randomization keeps arm sizes within one member.

name: experiment_results_reconcile
detail: The aggregated experiment population reconciles to the governed audience.
